messages.subject: Caspian Technologies Limited v Harburn Utilities plc — Letter before claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Sturrock,

We act for Caspian Technologies Limited. Please find attached our letter before claim. We invite a substantive response within 14 days, by 30 October 2025, together with the documents on which your client relies in support of the matters asserted in your letter of 8 August 2025.

Yours faithfully
James Osei

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Osei,

Receipt acknowledged. This matter is now with our solicitors, Pemberton Rowe LLP (Alistair Whitlock). Please direct future correspondence to them. Liability is denied and our client will be advancing a counterclaim.

Iain Sturrock
General Counsel, Harburn Utilities plc
